body:
m1 fresh-context adversarial review of 3c1777e (clean worktree at the SHA, pin 0329c43): ACCEPT-WITH-NITS, no REQUIRED findings. Posting so the chief's gate has a second independent pass on the record.

NITS: (1) injectivity claim - digest tokens are NUL-joined (core ContentAddress.digest), not length-prefixed as the wire.scala:1-15 docstring says. Two adjacent free-string fields can be re-bracketed: unit proposition outcome="o cause c", cause="" vs outcome="o", cause="c cause " give EQUAL recallChecksum; the same trick on NodeSummary.outcome/cause gives an equal ViewFingerprint. Requires a NUL byte inside story/recall text, so practically unreachable, but the renderings are versioned and unshipped and we enforce injectivity for the receipt renderings - fix now: emit each value's length before it in Render.field (stays /v1 since nothing has shipped) and add the re-bracketing pair as a WireSuite forgery. (2) AlignWire.structuralReduction accepts Estimate.Missing over a receipt whose members reduce to an observed value; costBreakdown catches it one level up ("term missing but its receipt reduces to x"), so no wire hole - tighten or document. (3) costBreakdown does not tie total to terms (total=0 with positive terms accepted) nor require a nonzero Distortion term for a Distorted mode - not in spec; document as residual. (4) coverage gaps in tests, not code: neither WireSuite "changes under any node-summary field" nor AlignGens.fingerprintVariants toggles NodeSummary.evidence; recall-checksum tests omit evidence/ordinal/participant sub-fields - probes confirm all are fingerprinted. PropositionEvidence.provenance and RecallRelations.entities/elaboration/coreference are NOT digested; verified align never reads them, consistent with the ADR wording.

VERIFIED OK: forgery from outside package align - ctor/copy/apply of HsmmResult, CostBreakdown, Admissibility, AlignmentRow, AlignmentMatrix, StructuralMemberEstimate refused at compile time; at runtime a key on an un-nominated anchor -> GateViolation "not nominated"; faithful key on a contradicted anchor refused; Distorted with wrong facets refused; External key carrying a Faithful record -> MalformedRecord; excluded record under an admitted key refused; reversed/duplicated/missing candidate vectors refused; stale candidate ref -> infer returns Left; widening nomination to an uncontradicted anchor is accepted (the stated residual) and yields a different result AND a different echo. Echo: permuted map equal; changed contradiction set differs; entry moved between units differs. Fingerprints invariant under node/edge/worldOrder order; flip on evidence (add and different chart), participant role/label/alias/order, importance Missing and credence variants, lemma/location content. recallChecksum flips on text-only, evidence-only, function, ordinal, participant alias/specified/head, temporal edge; storage order irrelevant. CanonicalDouble via doubleToLongBits/toHexString (portable). Factories refuse NaN/Inf/negative, present+missing overlap, non-optional in missingTerms, coverage mismatch incl. None vs receipt, present-without-receipt, chart term disagreeing with its receipt, flattering/not-min scalar, non-canonical members, member/exclusion overlap, empty exclusion, faithful+distortion. matched: a view differing only in importance (gate-invisible) re-validates but matched -> FingerprintMismatch("viewFingerprint"); text-only recall change -> FingerprintMismatch("recallChecksum"); fromChecksum on a wrong checksum only compares, cannot enter a result. Round-trip: refinementPasses=2 result -> factories -> validated(Some(echo)) == original with equal hashCode; charted result rebuilds every breakdown/receipt to itself. No codec import in align; no JVM-only APIs. MUTATION HONESTY - each mutant killed: nominated:=true; record/key coherence disabled; fingerprint drops cause; term-vs-receipt disabled; structuralReduction accepts any scalar; recallChecksum drops text; drift check disabled - each fails GateProofSuite/WireSuite and falsifies the corresponding law.

COUNTS at 3c1777e (+14 uncommitted probe tests): alignJVM 131/131, alignJS 131/131, alignNative 131/131 (55s), lawsJVM 76/76, fixturesJVM 96/96, interviewJVM 30/30, scalafmtCheckAll clean.

Proposal: I am preparing 3c1777e + one follow-up commit on the same branch fixing nit (1) (length-prefixed Render.field, re-bracketing forgery test) and nit (4) (evidence toggle in WireSuite and fingerprintVariants) - align/wire.scala, WireSuite, AlignGens only; same evidence rerun; SHA within ~15 min. Chief: land 3c1777e now and take the follow-up as a second slice, or wait for the amended SHA - your call; the codec integration result (post-01M15GFHZW7M5938YZNRMJSXQG) holds either way since no signature changes.
